content: Netflix plans to shut down two of its gaming studios, as reported by Game File and Variety, as it makes a bigger shift toward party games and titles streamed to TVs. One of the studios being shut down is Night School Studio, creators of the Oxenfree series. Netflix bought Night School in 2021, and it just released a horror experience called Unhinged for TVs and launched a mobile game in 2025 tied to Black Mirror. The other studio that’s set to close is Helsinki-based Moonloot Games, which was created in 2022. Netflix’s big push into TV-based games kicked off late last year and was a pivot from a mobile-focused approach that featured prestige indie titles. But Netflix has let many of those indie hits leave its mobile lineup as it focuses instead on four pillars of kids, party, narrative, and “mainstream” games. “As we continue to prioritize these areas, we see an opportunity to be more focused in our execution, so we are making organizational changes to the business to match those priorities,” Netflix spokesperson Chrissy Kelleher tells The Verge. Netflix is also eliminating “some” additional roles in its games business, according to Kelleher. The cuts include Tara Voelker, who says she was the “single accessibility person” on the gaming team. Last year, Netflix shut down the studio behind a Squid Game mobile title and sold Cozy Grove studio Spry Fox back to its original owners. In 2024, Netflix closed down a AAA studio that never released a game.

chineseContent: 据《Game File》和《Variety》报道，Netflix 计划关闭其两家游戏工作室，因为它正在向派对游戏和电视流媒体游戏进行更大的转变。被关闭的工作室之一是 Night School Studio，它是《Oxenfree》系列的创作者。 Netflix 于 2021 年收购了《夜校》，刚刚发布了一款名为《Unhinged》的电视恐怖体验游戏，并于 2025 年推出了一款与《黑镜》相关的手机游戏。另一家即将关闭的工作室是总部位于赫尔辛基的 Moonloot Games，该公司成立于 2022 年。Netflix 于去年底开始大举进军电视游戏，这是从以知名独立游戏为特色的以移动设备为中心的策略的一个支点。但 Netflix 已让许多热门独立游戏退出其移动产品阵容，转而专注于儿童、派对、叙事和“主流”游戏四大支柱。 Netflix 发言人 Chrissy Kelleher 告诉 The Verge：“随着我们继续优先考虑这些领域，我们看到了更加专注于执行的机会，因此我们正在对业务进行组织变革，以匹配这些优先事项。”凯莱赫表示，Netflix 还将取消其游戏业务中的“一些”额外角色。裁员对象包括塔拉·沃克 (Tara Voelker)，她说自己是游戏团队中的“唯一无障碍人员”。去年，Netflix 关闭了 Squid Game 手机游戏背后的工作室，并将 Cozy Grove 工作室 Spry Fox 卖回了原来的所有者。 2024 年，Netflix 关闭了一家从未发行过游戏的 AAA 工作室。
